evidence: A top_text_colors rgb(0,95,217) x129. B top_backgrounds rgb(39,209,255) x5, top_text_colors rgb(39,209,255) x8.

observation: A opens with a full-width photographic banner (three Honda Insight cars) behind the logo, search bar and account icons. B opens with a plain dark top bar and a text-led hero, with no banner image.

evidence: B h1 'The ultimate Honda Insight forum', font_size 64px, weight 700, text_align center. A h1_count 0, h1 null.

observation: A has no H1, and its headings are only two H3s. B has one H1, four H2s and three H3s in a hierarchical outline.

evidence: B semantic: nav 1, main 1, section 4. A semantic: nav 0, main 0, section 1.

evidence: A meta_names has 27 entries and jsonld_blocks 1. B meta_names is charset, viewport, description; jsonld_blocks 0.

evidence: A_facts title and lang 'en-US'; B_facts title and lang 'en'.

observation: B is styled with semantic or utility-free short class names, only 50 class uses across 21 unique classes. A has 1199 class uses across 254 unique classes, a framework-style naming system.
